mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metrics_samples (sampled_at, metric, metric_name, sample_value, sample_value2, resolution) VALUES (#{sampledAt}, #{metric}, #{name}, #{value}, #{value2}, #{resolution})

INSERT INTO metrics_samples (sampled_at, metric, metric_name, sample_value, sample_value2, resolution) SELECT , m.metric, m.metric_name, SUM(m.sample_value), NULL, 'HOUR' FROM metrics_samples m WHERE m.resolution = 'MIN' AND m.sampled_at < #{cutoff} AND m.metric IN ('PUBLISH','APPLY_JDBC','APPLY_ICEBERG') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metrics_samples h WHERE h.resolution = 'HOUR' AND h.sampled_at = AND h.metric = m.metric AND h.metric_name = m.metric_name) GROUP BY , m.metric, m.metric_name

INSERT INTO metrics_samples (sampled_at, metric, metric_name, sample_value, sample_value2, resolution) SELECT , m.metric, m.metric_name, MAX(m.sample_value), NULL, 'HOUR' FROM metrics_samples m WHERE m.resolution = 'MIN' AND m.sampled_at < #{cutoff} AND m.metric IN ('LAG_JDBC','LAG_ICEBERG') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metrics_samples h WHERE h.resolution = 'HOUR' AND h.sampled_at = AND h.metric = m.metric AND h.metric_name = m.metric_name) GROUP BY , m.metric, m.metric_name

INSERT INTO metrics_samples (sampled_at, metric, metric_name, sample_value, sample_value2, resolution) SELECT , m.metric, m.metric_name, CAST(AVG(m.sample_value) AS BIGINT), CAST(AVG(m.sample_value2) AS BIGINT), 'HOUR' FROM metrics_samples m WHERE m.resolution = 'MIN' AND m.sampled_at < #{cutoff} AND m.metric = 'RESOURCE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metrics_samples h WHERE h.resolution = 'HOUR' AND h.sampled_at = AND h.metric = m.metric AND h.metric_name = m.metric_name) GROUP BY , m.metric, m.metric_name

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM metrics_samples WHERE resolution = #{resolution} AND sampled_at < #{before}
